sections.title: S1: WARM UP
sections.description:
Weightlifting, Warm up 

a. Movement prep 
1 round of:
60/60 sec Dynamic Pec Stretch
60/60 sec Dynamic Lat Stretch
60/60 sec Dynamic Anterior Hip stretch
60/60 sec Dynamic Posterior Hip stretch

b. Activation 
1 round of:
Mini-band Posterior prep routine (20 alt. side steps, 20 goodmornings, 20 alt. side steps, 20 glute bridges)
A, T, W, Y, E, I banded shoulder routine (10 of each)

c. Weightlifting, P.C&J specific barbell prep
(Empty barbell)
5 Clean Pulls + 10 Extended pulls
-rest as needed-
5 Muscle Clean + 10 Strict Press (Alt. presses from front/back)
-rest as needed-
5 Power Clean + 10 Push Jerks (Alt. from front/back)
-rest as needed-
Start building up in weight.

sections.title: S1: STRENGTH-SPEED (Clean and Jerk)
sections.description:
Strength-Speed / "Power" / Weightlifting, Power Clean and Jerk

a. 9 sets, Going every 120 sec:
Set 1-3: 3 x 1 Power Clean and Jerk (Push or Split Jerk) with a 2 sec pause in both the receiving position of the Power Clean and the Jerk.
Set 4-6: 2 x 1 Power Clean and Jerk (Push or Split Jerk) with a 2 sec pause in both the receiving position of the Power Clean and the Jerk.
Set 7-9: 1 x 1 Power Clean and Jerk (Push or Split Jerk) with a 2 sec pause in both the receiving position of the Power Clean and the Jerk.

Load: (Suggested) (+2.5% from last week)
Set 1-3: 55-65% of 1RM Power Clean and Jerk (@55%1RM_PCLEAN_PJERK-@65%1RM_PCLEAN_PJERK)
Set 4-6: 65-75% of 1RM Power Clean and Jerk (@65%1RM_PCLEAN_PJERK-@75%1RM_PCLEAN_PJERK)
Set 7-9: 75-85% of 1RM Power Clean and Jerk (@75%1RM_PCLEAN_PJERK-@85%1RM_PCLEAN_PJERK)

Note: In this block we are going to focus on improving your catch position in the Power Clean and in the jerk by adding a pause on all of our lifts. The pause will build positional strength and awareness, which will make you stronger and more confident in the most challenging position (the catch). 

Progression: 
W1: 3 sets of 3 reps, 3 sets of 2 reps, 3 sets of 1 rep 
W2: Same volume and format, aim to progress loads.
W3: Same volume and format, aim to progress loads. (Current)
W4: Transition week

1.1.1: This means the reps are performed as singles (drop and go) and not touch and go.
----------------------------------

sections.title: S1: ABSOLUTE STRENGTH + STRENGTH ENDURANCE (Squat)
sections.description:
Strength, Anterior Lower-body (Squat) 

a. Absolute Strength
5 sets, Going every 3rd minute
5 Front squats* 
Load: (Suggested) (+2.5% from last week. Only increase if last week's sets moved well)
Set 1: 70% of 1RM (@70%1RM_FRONTSQ)
Set 2: 72.5% of 1RM (@72.5%1RM_FRONTSQ)
Set 3: 75% of 1RM (@75%1RM_FRONTSQ)
Set 4: 77.5% of 1RM (@77.5%1RM_FRONTSQ)
Set 5: 80% of 1RM (@80%1RM_FRONTSQ)

b. Strength Endurance
5 min EMOM
6 Thrusters
Load: (volume reduction from 8→6 this week, load increase by 4-5kg / 10lbs)
[Elite] 57-61/41-45kg │ 125-135/90-100lbs
[RX] 48-52/34-38kg │ 105-115/75-85lbs
[Intermediate] 38-42/29-34kg │ 85-95/65-75lbs

*Tempo: No tempo restrictions. 

Progression: 
W1: 
-5 sets of 5 Front squats (65, 67.5, 70, 72.5, 75% of 1RM)
-5 min EMOM: 10 Thrusters
W2: 
-5 sets of 5 Front squats (67.5, 70, 72.5, 75, 77.5% of 1RM)
-5 min EMOM: 8 Thrusters (Heavier than last week)
W3: (current)
-5 sets of 5 Front squats (70, 72.5, 75, 77.5, 80% of 1RM)
-5 min EMOM: 6 Thrusters (Heavier than last week)
W4:
-Transition week.
----------------------------------

sections.title: S2: CONDITIONING
sections.description:
Conditioning

a. 30 min AMRAP
10-20-30-40 etc.
Cal Ski
Cal C2 Bike
Intensity: "Building the basement" (60-65% effort / “Easy” / Moderate intensity domain / Z2)

-Rest 3 min-

5 sets, 2 min AMRAP / 1 min Rest
Set 1: 250/200m Ski + Max Distance C2 bike
Set 2: 300/250m Ski + Max Distance C2 bike
Set 3: 350/300m Ski + Max Distance C2 bike
Set 4: 400/350m Ski + Max Distance C2 bike
Set 5: 450/400m Ski + Max Distance C2 bike

-Rest 3 min-

5 sets, 2 min AMRAP / 1 min Rest
Set 1: 500/400m C2 bike + Max Distance Ski
Set 2: 600/500m C2 bike + Max Distance Ski
Set 3: 700/600m C2 bike + Max Distance Ski
Set 4: 800/700m Ski + Max Distance Ski
Set 5: 900/800m Ski + Max Distance Ski
Intensity: "Raising the ceiling" (80-85% effort / “Threshold” / Highest repeatable effort / Heavy-Severe Intensity domain / Z4)
